$comment: HTML strings the rewrite-probes project compiles as written and as each fix and context action of the analysis leaves them, and runs with plain, null, multi-line and hostile values (RewriteProbesTest.kt). A case is `fun f(params) = body`, with what it declares beside it; core's Html, Trusted and interpolate are imported. Every case says rewrite, what it offers: preferred, offered (and not preferred) or none; and marks, what its issues mark, each as written and in order, no more and no less, so a case the analysis says nothing of fails. says holds words some message must hold. Every cell of hole-matrix.json is compiled and run the same way.
